description: Declarative hardware-dependent layer tiers and per-host profiles for scripts/hardware_profile.py. Thresholds are sizing rules, not measurements; each host entry records where its numbers came from (native_proven measurement vs. labelled projection) per docs/acceptance-evidence-policy.md.

workflow_concurrency.rule: min(16, CPUs - reserved_cores), per agent-lab AGENTS.md's per-run concurrent-agent sizing

local_generation_model.description: Local generation model tier by GPU VRAM (discrete NVIDIA) or unified memory (Apple Silicon). Tiers are conservative floors for a quantized (4-bit/8-bit) model plus KV cache headroom, not a specific model's exact footprint.
local_generation_model.macos_unified_gpu_working_set_fraction_n: Labelled assumption, not a measurement: macOS reserves unified memory for the OS, foreground apps, and (on this project's configured local profile) a concurrent embedding/semantic-RAG stack, and caps the Metal working set below total RAM. 0.6 is a conservative floor, not Apple's documented default (undocumented and version-dependent); treat the resulting vram_gb as an upper bound on what a generation model can reliably claim, not a guarantee.

tiers.name: cpu-only
tiers.note: No GPU/unified-memory tier met; CPU inference only, small models.

tiers.name: small-8b-q4
tiers.note: ~7-8B parameter models at 4-bit quantization fit with headroom.

tiers.name: large-32b-q4
tiers.note: ~30-32B at 4-bit quantization, e.g. a 24GB laptop GPU.

tiers.name: unified-70b-plus
tiers.note: Apple unified memory hosts with enough headroom for OS + app usage alongside a large model.

embedding_semantic_rag.description: Fit for the SocratiCode embedding stack, a local Qdrant instance, and a local vLLM/embedding server sharing host RAM (docs/native-rag-runtime.md).

tiers.name: unsupported
tiers.note: Below the floor for embedding + Qdrant + vLLM concurrently; run remote or sequentially.

tiers.name: light
tiers.note: Small collections, one service at a time.

tiers.name: standard
tiers.note: SocratiCode + Qdrant + a small local embedding model concurrently.

tiers.name: full
tiers.note: SocratiCode + Qdrant + vLLM serving an embedding or small generation model concurrently, per this project's configured local profile.

tiers.name: headroom
tiers.note: Large collections and multiple concurrent local services with headroom for the rest of the workflow.

ecosystem_bounded_run.description: Suggested override values for the ECOSYSTEM_JOB_MEMORY_HIGH and ECOSYSTEM_JOB_MEMORY_MAX environment variables read by /home/example/codex-ecosystem/bin/ecosystem-bounded-run, which passes them straight through as systemd MemoryHigh/MemoryMax (wrapper defaults 4G/6G). Those defaults are the WSL-stability containment floor from docs/tasks/2026-09-22-wsl-stability-fix.md; this rule only raises the ceiling for hosts with RAM headroom, is bounded well below total RAM, and is never applied automatically -- exporting the two named variables is a deliberate per-host choice.

sizing_arithmetic.workflow_concurrency_cap: min(16, 60 - 2) = 16 (nproc inside WSL is the .wslconfig processors=60)
sizing_arithmetic.effective_ram_gb: script prefers measured /proc/meminfo over .wslconfig's configured ceiling; projected proc_meminfo=111 (wslconfig_memory_gb=112 minus ~1GB VM overhead, as observed on this-host-20260923: wslconfig=48 -> meminfo=47)

hosts.note: Projected, not measured on this host. WSL settings are the user's 2026-09-23 decision (memory=112GB, processors=60, swap=16GB, networkingMode=mirrored, [experimental] autoMemoryReclaim=gradual, sparseVhd=true), replacing the earlier 100/96 GB proposals: laptop measurements (Windows outside WSL held about 24 GB with 9 GB free; commit charge 85.7 of 99.7 GB) showed a cap near 128 GB would page Windows. Re-measure under full load on the workstation and raise toward 116-120 GB only if Windows keeps more than 12 GB free. A fresh run of scripts/hardware_profile.py on that workstation is required before treating these numbers as native_proven.
